scientific_integrity: No claim of independent certification, priority proof or experimental exhaustive validation. Analytic proof and reproducibility code are supplied; the code is auxiliary to the proof.
scientific_limitations: Four equally spaced independent equal-power complex Gaussian spectral lines and a fixed Gaussian window only; expected spectrogram-zero intensity rather than individual sample peaks. General logarithmic-potential intensity is prior theory. Possible equivalent older exponential-family classification remains unexcluded. No independent review.
title: Exact saddle-node threshold for four-line Gaussian spectrogram zero intensities
